outcome_definitions.mean_actuator_risk: continuous reachability-weighted load averaged over 120 steps, not an event probability
outcome_definitions.task_utility_mean: model task score including observed benign protocol-success probabilities and declared penalties, not measured robot mission success
outcome_definitions.mean_cost_per_node: mean_cost / N; full same-step network plus guard cost
outcome_definitions.benign_success_fraction: benign_success_mass / benign_request_mass; denominator is preserved and zero is undefined, not zero success

unit: one simulated environment trial within a fixed scene and N, not a node, time step, batch call, or policy row
pairing: identical seed and exogenous environment for all policies; common scene-N environment stream across settings; overlapping trials remain the same clusters
estimates: all setting-policy means and all declared paired mean/median differences and paired superiority fractions; no winner selection
bootstrap: resample whole environment trial IDs; one 2000-draw bank per scene-N-trial-count shared across policies, outcomes and settings; secondary settings use the common 48-trial bank; no inference pooling primary and secondary banks, whose underlying trials overlap
intervals: 95% percentile paired trial bootstrap, pointwise not simultaneous; fixed scenes, point calibration, conditional simulated population
tests: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, Pratt zeros, zero tolerance 1e-12; tests symmetric paired differences, not specifically their mean; all-zero differences p=1
multiplicity: one Holm family across all primary setting-outcome-contrasts and a separate family across all secondary ones, never split by favorable result or figure
missingness: full configuration-policy-trial grid required; missing/failed trials prevent a completed confirmatory analysis; all failed attempts retained
boundaries: Different role schedules change actual kernels, not the initial random population.
Common random numbers across noise types are not identical perturbed values.
Task-penalty and semantic-weight sensitivity can change outcome definitions and cannot be pooled as replications.
Point-calibration tests do not incorporate semantic calibration uncertainty; a separate joint-draw experiment is required.
Batch wall time is diagnostic here, not isolated latency or throughput evidence.
Snapshot certificate diagnostics do not establish a time-varying closed-loop guarantee.
The two joint-parameter profiles and joint-error scenario are named stress tests, not exhaustive robustness guarantees.
